subject.title: [Feature]: Support non-durable native dreaming mode / explicit phase controls

question: Should managed production Dreaming gain a stable report-only promotion policy, expose individual phase switches, or keep non-durable operation limited to the existing on-demand harness?
rationale: The repository currently treats phases as internal and has a high bar for new configuration; source inspection cannot determine which public compatibility contract maintainers want to support long-term.

options.title: Add report-only promotion policy
options.body: Keep phases internal and add one supported mode that runs the normal analysis pipeline while prohibiting durable promotion and emitting an audit result.

options.title: Expose phase controls
options.body: Make light, REM, and deep independently configurable, accepting a larger public API tied to current implementation details.

options.title: Keep harness-only workflow
options.body: Document `rem-harness` as the sole non-durable path and decline scheduled production reflection without durable promotion.

recommendation.title: Add report-only promotion policy
recommendation.body: Keep phases internal and add one supported mode that runs the normal analysis pipeline while prohibiting durable promotion and emitting an audit result.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail identifies this person as the original dreaming architecture author and therefore the best available owner for its permanent public boundary.
